title: A Model of (Often Mixed) Stereotype Content: Competence and Warmth Respectively Follow from Perceived Status and Competition

publication.publisher_or_container: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, Vol. 82, No. 6

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the stereotype content model: warmth and competence are the two primary dimensions; mixed clusters (high warmth/low competence = paternalistic; high competence/low warmth = envious) produce distinct emotions. Noted the 2019 erratum on wording of correlation coefficients, which does not affect the qualitative claims used.

copyright.notes: APA journal article; analytical citation only.
